title: Shay Locomotives
summary: Shay Locomotives is a website dedicated to the geared steam locomotives invented by Ephraim Shay in the 1870s, primarily used in narrow gauge logging and industrial railway operations. The site appears to serve locomotive enthusiasts and historians with information about this distinctive locomotive design.
problem_solved: This is not a technology solution but rather an informational resource about historical steam-powered locomotives used in logging operations.
why_valuable: Provides historical preservation and education about Shay locomotives for rail enthusiasts and historians.
